messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — SOC2 reviewer follow-up. Theyneed a tamper-evident evidence package for the Dec 12 incident: timeline for the ~23m RBAC escalation, KMS access events, PR/approval history, and the forensic snapshot we pulled. Request also asks for a signed manifest and verifier steps.
alan: I can assemble. Do they want raw logs or a signed bundle (manifest+checksums+pubkey)?
sarah: Signed bundle + manifest preferred. Auditor wants SHA256 of each artifact and a CSV mapping of control IDs -> artifact paths.
mike: PR reference: https://git.redwood/internal/repo/pulls/5823 — approved by me at 2025-12-12T03:10:21Z. Diff and approver audit are in code-audit bucket.
alan: KMS query I ran (subset):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey --start-time 2025-12-12T02:45:00Z --end-time 2025-12-12T03:15:00Z
```
Exported results -> s3://redwood-evidence/forensics/2025-12-12/kms-cloudtrail.json (interim sha256: 1f8b...)
sarah: Key ARN involved: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01. I exported key metadata + policy snapshot:
```
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id abcd-ef01 --policy-name default > kms-policy-20251212.json
aws kms list-key-rotation-status --key-id abcd-ef01 > key-rotation.log
```
mike: RBAC drift: service account `svc-model-ingest` was temporarily added to `infra-admins` via PR 5823. PR description documents justification and rollback plan. PR approval history included in pr-5823.bundle.tar.gz.
auditor_jane: Reviewer asks for confirmation there was no lateral access or privilege escalation beyond the scoped change. Need authz/flow evidence.
alan: I ran our internal authz scan:
```
./scripts/authz-scan --since 2025-12-12T03:00Z --until 2025-12-12T04:00Z --output lateral-check.json
```
No new rolebindings granting cluster-admin across accounts. lateral-check.json uploaded -> s3://redwood-evidence/forensics/2025-12-12/lateral-check.json (sha256: 8a6f...)
sarah: Collected VPC flow logs for the instance pool in the window; exported parquet -> s3://redwood-evidence/forensics/2025-12-12/vpc-flows.parquet. No unexpected egress observed.
alan: Kube audit subset exported (control-plane) for 2025-12-12T02:40Z..2025-12-12T04:00Z -> kube-audit.json. Forensic snapshot (filesystems, process list) stored in s3://redwood-evidence/forensics/2025-12-12/forensic-snapshot.tar.gz
alan: Proposed packaging steps (so auditor can reproduce):
1) export cloudtrail subset -> kms-cloudtrail.json
2) export kube-audit -> kube-audit.json
3) collect PR bundle -> pr-5823.bundle.tar.gz
4) collect KMS policy + rotation history -> kms-policy-20251212.json, key-rotation.log
5) run authz-scan -> lateral-check.json
6) include VPC flows and forensic snapshot -> vpc-flows.parquet, forensic-snapshot.tar.gz
7) compute SHA256 for each artifact, generate manifest.csv
8) sign manifest.csv with security PGP key and include pubkey and verification instructions
I scripted this at tools/evidence/package_incident_20251212.sh.
mike: Added incident postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/incident/2025-12-12-priv-escalation (has timeline, impact, remediation steps).
auditor_jane: Tamper-evident requirement: manifest must be signed and verification steps documented. Also need retention proof for CloudTrail/KMS/kube-audit.
sarah: Retention exports: s3://redwood-evidence/forensics/retention-policies/retention-exports-20251213.json (shows 365d retention for CloudTrail/KMS/kube-audit).
alan: I'll compute SHA256 checksums, create manifest.csv, then PGP-sign it with security key id 0xBEEF1234:
```
gpg --default-key 0xBEEF1234 --output manifest.csv.sig --detach-sign manifest.csv
```
Will include pubkey at pubkeys/security-2025.pub and verifier steps: `gpg --import pubkeys/security-2025.pub` then `gpg --verify manifest.csv.sig manifest.csv`.
alan: Upload plan: bundle, manifest, signature, and pubkey -> s3://redwood-evidence/forensics/2025-12-12/bundle-signed.tar.gz
mike: I'll prepare the control-mapping doc mapping artifacts -> SOC2 CC6/CC7 control IDs and our internal control IDs (RID-1002, RID-2101).
auditor_jane: ETA? Auditor needs delivery by 2025-12-14 EOD.
alan: We can meet that. I'll upload and post link here.
alan: uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/forensics/2025-12-12/bundle-signed.tar.gz (sha256: 3c7d2a5e...)
alan: manifest.csv.sig and pubkeys/security-2025.pub included in bundle. Verification commands added in README.
auditor_jane: Received. I'll validate signatures and cross-check control mappings. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
mike: Ping me for any live or ad-hoc queries, I can run them and provide fresh exports.
alan: Closing loop once auditor confirms verification complete.
